priorMeasurementList.measuredWhatText: Ed-Fi to CEDS, property tier: the AI judge, run blind, against Ed-Fi's own published CEDS crosswalk, on the 65 sampled Ed-Fi elements that crosswalk maps
priorMeasurementList.resultText: the judge chose Ed-Fi's mapped CEDS property for 47 of the 65 (72.3%)
priorMeasurementList.buildText: blind-evaluation build DEV_edfiBlindEvalV2_080326 (an earlier hub and judge configuration)

priorMeasurementList.measuredWhatText: Ed-Fi to CEDS, every element: the AI judge's mappings against Ed-Fi's published crosswalk (666 authored mappings)
priorMeasurementList.resultText: 421 agreed; precision 80.96% (of the judge's 520 mappings), recall 63.2% (of the crosswalk's 666)

priorMeasurementList.measuredWhatText: A peer bridge pilot, Ed-Fi to LIF directly (no hub): the judge's 49 picks from 300 Ed-Fi subjects, each ruled by a separate AI agent working blind, NOT by people (the pilot's report says so)
priorMeasurementList.resultText: 19 of 49 picks ruled same or close (2 same, 17 close), 10 of 10 at confidence 0.8 and above; the supervisor's stand-down, removing rulings that rest on an undefined LIF element, puts it at 13 of 49 and 7 of 10
priorMeasurementList.buildText: peer bridge pilot run; peer mappings are not part of this graph
